limitations: Fixtures are complete synthetic computational units; members and pairs within a fixture are not independent samples.
co_membership_evidence is deterministic support, not probability.
No candidate view writes formal_membership_edge, authored membership, route path, or public model state.
Space role records are separate from relation evidence and remain unavailable when the domain is missing.
No absolute distance threshold is used; relative recipes are reported side by side.
The external truth manifest is not read by the probe and is not evidence of psychological validity.

B1.reason: estimand, prior, likelihood, spatial dependence, identifiability and calibration are not owner-approved

D0.description: describe_group_relations evidence plus local relation vectors

M1.reason: feature representation, algorithm, hyperparameters, seed and validation target are not pre-registered; no dependency installation

membership_estimand.partition_policy: no unique partition; overlapping candidates remain separate
membership_estimand.probability_policy: co_membership_evidence is deterministic support, not probability
membership_estimand.singleton_policy: retain as explicit identity/unassigned diagnostic; never infer positive group by singleton
membership_estimand.target: candidate member sets over authored furniture-group ids
membership_estimand.truth_policy: truth is evaluation-side computational structure and is not read by candidate probe

scale.formula: include pair when normalized_gap <= inclusive_linear_quantile(all computed normalized gaps, q)
scale.provenance: pre-registered D1 relative scale; no absolute distance threshold

scale.formula: rank neighbors by normalized_gap per endpoint; include pair when max(endpoint ranks) <= window and it persists in at least p declared windows
include pair when declared space profile >= inclusive_linear_quantile(available profiles, q)
scale.provenance: pre-registered D1 space-field scale; absent profiles remain missing

synthetic_holdout.holdout_reason: this checkpoint freezes the estimand and split/metric contract; generated seed replicas and owner-approved truth targets are not yet materialized

metrics.formula: predicted within-candidate authored-group pairs intersect computational-truth pairs, reported by recipe and family; F1 is descriptive only
for each truth candidate set, report the distribution of Jaccard against all emitted candidates; do not choose one production candidate
truth members appearing in at least one emitted candidate divided by truth members
truth members represented only in ambiguous/overlapping outputs divided by truth members
truth members emitted only as unassigned divided by truth members

synthetic_holdout.rule: assign whole fixture family and seed replicas; never split members or pairs across development and holdout
synthetic_holdout.threshold_policy: deferred; no numerical pass threshold or recipe winner is allowed in this checkpoint

truth_input.reason: probe CLI accepts fixture manifest only; computational truth is external
